common.questions: Questions? Reply to this e-mail, write to {email} or call {phone}.

shipping.title: Delivery
shipping.freightNote: Our manager will agree the freight price and delivery time with you separately.

payment.title: Payment
payment.bankIntro: Please pay for the order by bank transfer using these details:
payment.afterPayment: We ship within 1–3 business days after receiving the payment.
payment.invoiceFollows: We will send the invoice with payment details in a separate e-mail. Please use the order number {number} as the payment reference.
payment.invoiceIssued: Invoice {invoice} has been issued — please pay it by the due date shown on it.
payment.invoiceLater: We will send the invoice with the payment term in a separate e-mail.
payment.cashOnPickup: Pay when collecting the order at the warehouse: {address}. We will let you know when it is ready.
payment.card: Once the payment is confirmed, we will prepare your order for shipping.

orderConfirmation.subject: Order {number} received
orderConfirmation.title: Thank you for your order!
orderConfirmation.intro: We have received your order {number}. Here is a summary and what happens next.
orderConfirmation.next: When the order is shipped, you will receive an e-mail with a tracking link.
orderConfirmation.guestNote: Create an account with this e-mail address to keep track of your orders and invoices in one place.

orderShipped.subject: Order {number} has been shipped
orderShipped.preheader: Your order {number} is on its way.
orderShipped.title: Your order is on its way!
orderShipped.intro: Order {number} has been handed over to the carrier.
orderShipped.lockerNote: When the parcel arrives at the locker, the carrier will send you an SMS or e-mail with the pickup code.
orderShipped.noTracking: If you have any questions about the delivery, just reply to this e-mail.

orderCancelled.subject: Order {number} has been cancelled
orderCancelled.title: Order cancelled
orderCancelled.intro: We would like to let you know that order {number} has been cancelled.
orderCancelled.refund: As the order had already been paid, we will refund the money to the account the payment was made from within 5 business days.
orderCancelled.unpaid: If an invoice was issued for this order, it no longer needs to be paid.
orderCancelled.mistake: If the cancellation is a mistake or you would like to restore the order, reply to this e-mail — we are happy to help.

invoiceIssued.subject: {type} {number}
invoiceIssued.creditNote: The credit note reduces the amount of a previously issued invoice — no further action is needed.
invoiceIssued.noAttachment: We could not attach the PDF this time — you will find the document in your account, or we can send it on request.

b2bApproved.subject: Your business account is approved
b2bApproved.title: Welcome to B2B!
b2bApproved.intro: The B2B application for {company} has been approved.
b2bApproved.prices: When signed in, you will see your prices excluding VAT in the catalogue.
b2bApproved.terms: Payment by invoice — {days} days payment term.
b2bApproved.reverse: For deliveries to Estonia and Lithuania with a valid EU VAT number, the reverse charge applies.

b2bRejected.subject: About your B2B application
b2bRejected.title: B2B application not approved
b2bRejected.intro: Thank you for your interest! Unfortunately, we cannot approve the B2B application for {company} at this time.
b2bRejected.text: You can still shop as a private customer. If you would like to update your company details or learn more, reply to this e-mail or contact us.
